meta.topic: 购物、比较商品、询价讲价与智能家电

1.title: 旧自行车与新选择
1.subtitle: 先发现旧车的问题，再到自行车店试车。

steps.title: 车已经太矮了
steps.prompt: 看看这张图，你发现了什么？
steps.sentence: 这辆自行车有点儿旧，而且对小雪来说太矮了。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 这是一辆自行车。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Zhè shì yí liàng zìxíngchē.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 它有点儿旧，而且对小雪来说太矮了。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Tā yǒudiǎnr jiù, érqiě duì Xiǎoxuě lái shuō tài ǎi le.

steps.title: 去店里试新车
steps.prompt: 你觉得这辆车适合小雪吗？
steps.sentence: 买自行车以前，让小雪先试一下。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 我觉得可能合适，但是小雪应该先试一下。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Wǒ juéde kěnéng héshì, dànshì Xiǎoxuě yīnggāi xiān shì yíxià.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 试了以后，才知道大小合不合适。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Shì le yǐhòu, cái zhīdào dàxiǎo hé bù héshì.

2.title: 比较短裤和裙子
2.subtitle: 观察颜色、大小、款式、价格和促销。

steps.title: 试穿黄色短裤
steps.prompt: 短裤的颜色和大小怎么样？
steps.sentence: 这条黄色短裤的大小很合适。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 这是一条黄色的短裤。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Zhè shì yì tiáo huángsè de duǎnkù.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 这条短裤的大小很合适。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Zhè tiáo duǎnkù de dàxiǎo hěn héshì.

steps.title: 比较以后再决定
steps.prompt: 她应该买裙子还是短裤？
steps.sentence: 裙子更好看，也很适合她，但她想多看看再决定。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 我觉得裙子比短裤更好看，也更适合她。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Wǒ juéde qúnzi bǐ duǎnkù gèng hǎokàn, yě gèng shìhé tā.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 她可以多看看、比较价格以后再决定。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Tā kěyǐ duō kànkan, bǐjiào jiàgé yǐhòu zài juédìng.

3.title: 水果店询价与讲价
3.subtitle: 试吃西瓜、认识重量和人民币单位。

steps.title: 先尝一块冰西瓜
steps.prompt: 如果你是店员，你会怎么介绍西瓜？
steps.sentence: 这块冰西瓜又新鲜又甜，吃起来甜极了。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 我们的西瓜又大又新鲜。
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Wǒmen de xīguā yòu dà yòu xīnxiān.

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 您先尝尝这块冰西瓜，甜极了！
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Nín xiān chángchang zhè kuài bīng xīguā, tián jí le!

steps.title: 称重、询价和讲价
steps.promptEn: Can you bargain when buying groceries?
steps.sentence: 西瓜按公斤卖，香蕉买两斤，一共五十八块五毛。

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 买得多，便宜点儿怎么样？
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Mǎi de duō, piányi diǎnr zěnmeyàng?

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 十五块，行不行？
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Shíwǔ kuài, xíng bu xíng?

sampleAnswers.hanzi: 一共十五块三毛，十五块行不行？
sampleAnswers.pinyin: Yígòng shíwǔ kuài sān máo, shíwǔ kuài xíng bu xíng?

tips.label: 礼貌提出价格

tips.examplePinyin: Yígòng shíwǔ kuài sān máo, shíwǔ kuài xíng bu xíng?

sampleAnswers.pinyin: Zhège diànshì yǐjīng yòngle hěn jiǔ, shì shíhou huàn yí ge xīn de le.

grammar.title: 连动句“V1着V2”
grammar.titleEn: V1-zhe as the manner of V2
grammar.scene: How do you say that someone performs one action in a continuing posture while doing another?
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词1 + 着 +（宾语1）+ 动词2 +（宾语2）
grammar.explanation: “着”放在第一个动词后，表示进行第二个动作时保持的状态或方式。

examples.hanzi: 弟弟吃着苹果写作业。
examples.english: The younger brother does homework while eating an apple.
examples.pinyin: Dìdi chīzhe píngguǒ xiě zuòyè.

examples.hanzi: 他们坐着看电视。
examples.english: They watch television while sitting.
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zuòzhe kàn diànshì.

examples.hanzi: 老师拿着书走进教室。
examples.english: The teacher walks into the classroom holding a book.
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī názhe shū zǒujìn jiàoshì.

examples.hanzi: 她笑着跟大家说再见。
examples.english: She says goodbye to everyone with a smile.
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàozhe gēn dàjiā shuō zàijiàn.

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢听着音乐做饭。
examples.english: I like cooking while listening to music.
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan tīngzhe yīnyuè zuòfàn.

grammar.title: 比较句“比……更”与“不比”
grammar.titleEn: Comparisons with 更 and 不比
grammar.scene: How do you compare two products when one has a stronger quality, or when the difference is small?
grammar.structure: A + 比 + B + 更/还 + 形容词；A + 不比 + B + 形容词（+ 多少）
grammar.explanation: “更/还”加强比较程度；“A不比B……”常用于说明两者差不多，或反驳原来的判断。

examples.hanzi: 这辆自行车比那辆更轻。
examples.english: This bicycle is lighter than that one.
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng zìxíngchē bǐ nà liàng gèng qīng.

examples.hanzi: 今天比昨天还热。
examples.english: Today is even hotter than yesterday.
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān hái rè.

examples.hanzi: 这家店不比那家贵。
examples.english: This shop is not more expensive than that one.
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn bù bǐ nà jiā guì.

examples.hanzi: 坐地铁不比骑自行车慢多少。
examples.english: Taking the subway is not much slower than cycling.
examples.pinyin: Zuò dìtiě bù bǐ qí zìxíngchē màn duōshao.

examples.hanzi: 这台电视比旧电视更方便。
examples.english: This television is more convenient than the old one.
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái diànshì bǐ jiù diànshì gèng fāngbiàn.

grammar.title: 程度补语“极了”
grammar.titleEn: Extremely: adjective or mental verb + 极了
grammar.scene: How do you show that a quality or feeling reaches a very high degree?
grammar.structure: 形容词 / 心理动词 + 极了
grammar.explanation: “极了”放在形容词或心理动词后，表示程度非常高。

examples.hanzi: 今天买的香蕉新鲜极了。
examples.english: The bananas bought today are extremely fresh.
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān mǎi de xiāngjiāo xīnxiān jí le.

examples.hanzi: 这个故事有意思极了。
examples.english: This story is extremely interesting.
examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi yǒuyìsi jí le.

examples.hanzi: 下雨以后，草原漂亮极了。
examples.english: The grassland is extremely beautiful after the rain.
examples.pinyin: Xiàyǔ yǐhòu, cǎoyuán piàoliang jí le.

examples.hanzi: 收到这个礼物，她高兴极了。
examples.english: She was extremely happy to receive this gift.
examples.pinyin: Shōudào zhège lǐwù, tā gāoxìng jí le.

examples.hanzi: 这件黄色的衣服我喜欢极了。
examples.english: I like this yellow item of clothing very much.
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn huángsè de yīfu wǒ xǐhuan jí le.

grammar.title: 递进复句“不但……而且……”
grammar.scene: How do you add a second, stronger reason when recommending a product?
grammar.structure: 同主语：主语 + 不但……，而且……；不同主语：不但 + 主语1……，而且 + 主语2……
grammar.explanation: 两个分句表示递进关系。主语相同时“不但”在主语后；主语不同时“不但”放在第一个主语前。

examples.hanzi: 这家店不但东西多，而且服务也很好。
examples.english: This shop not only has many products, but also provides good service.
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn búdàn dōngxi duō, érqiě fúwù yě hěn hǎo.

examples.hanzi: 小雪不但会骑自行车，而且骑得很快。
examples.english: Xiaoxue can not only ride a bicycle, but also rides very fast.
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxuě búdàn huì qí zìxíngchē, érqiě qí de hěn kuài.

examples.hanzi: 这个水果不但新鲜，而且很甜。
examples.english: This fruit is not only fresh, but also sweet.
examples.pinyin: Zhège shuǐguǒ búdàn xīnxiān, érqiě hěn tián.

examples.hanzi: 不但哥哥喜欢这台电视，而且妹妹也喜欢。
examples.english: Not only the older brother likes this television; the younger sister likes it too.
examples.pinyin: Búdàn gēge xǐhuan zhè tái diànshì, érqiě mèimei yě xǐhuan.

examples.hanzi: 网上买东西不但方便，而且常常更便宜。
examples.english: Online shopping is not only convenient, but also often cheaper.
examples.pinyin: Wǎngshang mǎi dōngxi búdàn fāngbiàn, érqiě chángcháng gèng piányi.

grammar.title: 词义辨析“适合”与“合适”
grammar.titleEn: Word choice: 适合 vs. 合适
grammar.scene: Both words can mean “suitable,” but where do they go in a sentence?
grammar.structure: 适合：事物 / 活动 + 适合 + 人 / 用途；合适：主语 + 很 / 不 + 合适
grammar.explanation: “适合”是动词，后面常带对象，说明什么适合谁或适合做什么；“合适”是形容词，说明大小、时间、价格或安排恰当，后面一般不直接带对象。

examples.hanzi: 这件黄色的裙子很适合你。
examples.english: This yellow skirt suits you well.
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn huángsè de qúnzi hěn shìhé nǐ.

examples.hanzi: 这双鞋的大小很合适。
examples.english: The size of these shoes is just right.
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié de dàxiǎo hěn héshì.

examples.hanzi: 这辆自行车不适合小雪。
examples.english: This bicycle is not suitable for Xiaoxue.
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng zìxíngchē bù shìhé Xiǎoxuě.

examples.hanzi: 明天下午三点开会合适吗？
examples.english: Is 3 p.m. tomorrow a suitable time for the meeting?
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn kāihuì héshì ma?

examples.hanzi: 我觉得这份工作很适合他。
examples.english: I think this job suits him well.
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè fèn gōngzuò hěn shìhé tā.

texts.title: 给小雪买辆新自行车
texts.setting: 在家里，王一雪和刘明商量去买东西。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 这辆自行车是小雪八岁的时候买的，看起来有点儿旧了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè liàng zìxíngchē shì Xiǎoxuě bā suì de shíhou mǎi de, kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎnr jiù le.
lines.english: This bicycle was bought when Xiaoxue was eight years old; it looks a bit old.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 是啊，她现在长高了，这辆车已经太矮了。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, tā xiànzài zhǎng gāo le, zhè liàng chē yǐjīng tài ǎi le.
lines.english: Yes. She has grown taller, and this bicycle is already too low for her.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 商场里开了一家自行车店，咱们给她买辆新的吧。
lines.pinyin: Shāngchǎng li kāile yì jiā zìxíngchē diàn, zánmen gěi tā mǎi liàng xīn de ba.
lines.english: A bicycle shop opened in the mall. Let us buy her a new one.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 好，咱们带小雪一起去，让她试一下。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, zánmen dài Xiǎoxuě yìqǐ qù, ràng tā shì yíxià.
lines.english: Okay. Let us take Xiaoxue with us and let her try one.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 那今天就去吧！我也想再看看衣服。咱们怎么去？
lines.pinyin: Nà jīntiān jiù qù ba! Wǒ yě xiǎng zài kànkan yīfu. Zánmen zěnme qù?
lines.english: Then let us go today! I also want to look at some clothes. How shall we get there?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 商场不远，咱们可以走着去。
lines.pinyin: Shāngchǎng bù yuǎn, zánmen kěyǐ zǒuzhe qù.
lines.english: The mall is not far. We can walk there.

texts.title: 裙子比短裤更好看
texts.setting: 在商场，刘明和王一雪买完自行车，又来挑选衣服。

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 你看我穿这条黄色的短裤好看吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn wǒ chuān zhè tiáo huángsè de duǎnkù hǎokàn ma?
lines.english: Do you think I look good wearing these yellow shorts?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 大小合适，但我觉得那条裙子比短裤更好看。
lines.pinyin: Dàxiǎo héshì, dàn wǒ juéde nà tiáo qúnzi bǐ duǎnkù gèng hǎokàn.
lines.english: The size is right, but I think that skirt looks better than the shorts.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 裙子比短裤贵一点儿。
lines.pinyin: Qúnzi bǐ duǎnkù guì yìdiǎnr.
lines.english: The skirt is a little more expensive than the shorts.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 贵多少？
lines.pinyin: Guì duōshao?
lines.english: How much more expensive?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.pinyin: Qúnzi sìbǎi bā, duǎnkù sìbǎi.
lines.english: The skirt is 480 yuan, and the shorts are 400 yuan.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 裙子不比短裤贵多少，还是买裙子吧，你穿裙子更好看。
lines.pinyin: Qúnzi bù bǐ duǎnkù guì duōshao, háishì mǎi qúnzi ba, nǐ chuān qúnzi gèng hǎokàn.
lines.english: The skirt is not much more expensive than the shorts. Buy the skirt; you look better in it.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我多看看再决定。你看，那边有买二送一！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ duō kànkan zài juédìng. Nǐ kàn, nàbian yǒu mǎi èr sòng yī!
lines.english: I will look around more before deciding. Look, there is a buy-two-get-one-free offer over there!

texts.title: 不甜不要钱
texts.setting: 在水果店，王一雪买西瓜和香蕉。

lines.speaker: 店员
lines.hanzi: 西瓜又大又新鲜，不甜不要钱！
lines.pinyin: Xīguā yòu dà yòu xīnxiān, bù tián bú yào qián!
lines.english: The watermelons are big and fresh. If they are not sweet, you do not pay!

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 西瓜看起来不错，怎么卖？
lines.pinyin: Xīguā kàn qǐlai búcuò, zěnme mài?
lines.english: The watermelons look good. How much are they?

lines.speaker: 店员
lines.hanzi: 五块钱一公斤。来，您先尝尝这块冰西瓜，甜极了！
lines.pinyin: Wǔ kuài qián yì gōngjīn. Lái, nín xiān chángchang zhè kuài bīng xīguā, tián jí le!
lines.english: Five yuan per kilogram. Here, try this chilled watermelon first. It is extremely sweet!

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 是挺甜的！帮我选个大点儿的，再来两斤香蕉。
lines.pinyin: Shì tǐng tián de! Bāng wǒ xuǎn gè dà diǎnr de, zài lái liǎng jīn xiāngjiāo.
lines.english: It is quite sweet! Please choose a bigger one for me, and give me two jin of bananas too.

lines.speaker: 店员
lines.hanzi: 一共五十八块五毛。
lines.pinyin: Yígòng wǔshíbā kuài wǔ máo.
lines.english: The total is 58 yuan and 5 mao.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 我买了这么多，便宜点儿吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile zhème duō, piányi diǎnr ba.
lines.english: I bought so much. Please make it a little cheaper.

lines.speaker: 店员
lines.hanzi: 您给我五十五吧。不能再便宜了。
lines.pinyin: Nín gěi wǒ wǔshíwǔ ba. Bù néng zài piányi le.
lines.english: You can give me 55 yuan. I cannot make it any cheaper.

texts.title: 是时候换个新电视了
texts.author: 刘明
texts.setting: 在家里，刘明介绍自己选择新电视的经历。
texts.translationPolicy: English is a teacher-authored support translation; the Chinese and pinyin preserve the textbook text.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 这几天我们在新家坐着看电视的时候，又发现了新问题。房子大了，电视看起来就有点儿小。这个电视是我们结婚时买的，是时候换个新电视了。今天我一直在网上选电视，没想到，现在的电视不但便宜，而且用着非常方便，有的电视叫它一声就能开机。我看了好几个，都很满意，晚上让一雪来决定吧。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān wǒmen zài xīn jiā zuòzhe kàn diànshì de shíhou, yòu fāxiàn le xīn wèntí. Fángzi dà le, diànshì kàn qǐlai jiù yǒudiǎnr xiǎo. Zhège diànshì shì wǒmen jiéhūn shí mǎi de, shì shíhou huàn gè xīn diànshì le. Jīntiān wǒ yìzhí zài wǎngshang xuǎn diànshì, méi xiǎngdào, xiànzài de diànshì búdàn piányi, érqiě yòngzhe fēicháng fāngbiàn, yǒude diànshì jiào tā yì shēng jiù néng kāijī. Wǒ kànle hǎo jǐ gè, dōu hěn mǎnyì, wǎnshang ràng Yīxuě lái juédìng ba.
lines.english: In the past few days, while sitting and watching television in our new home, we found another problem. The house is bigger, so the television looks a little small. We bought it when we got married, and it is time to replace it. I have been choosing televisions online today. Unexpectedly, televisions today are not only affordable but also very convenient to use. Some can power on when you call to them. I looked at several and liked them all. I will let Yixue decide tonight.

g07_01.scene: How do you say that someone performs one action in a continuing posture while doing another?
g07_01.structure: 主语 + 动词1 + 着 +（宾语1）+ 动词2 +（宾语2）
g07_01.structureEn: V1-zhe as the manner of V2

leadExamples.english: We can go there on foot.
He looks at the product while talking.

structureVariants.label: 基本结构
structureVariants.formula: 主语 + 动词1 + 着 +（宾语1）+ 动词2 +（宾语2）
structureVariants.explanation: “着”放在第一个动词后，说明做第二个动作时保持的状态或方式。

followUp.promptEn: The girl smiles while trying the bicycle.

g07_02.scene: How do you compare two products when one has a stronger quality, or when the difference is small?
g07_02.structure: A + 比 + B + 更/还 + 形容词；A + 不比 + B + 形容词（+ 多少）
g07_02.structureEn: Comparisons with 更 and 不比

leadExamples.english: The skirt looks better than the shorts.
The skirt is not much more expensive than the shorts.
This one is even more suitable.

oralQuestions: 这条裙子和这条短裤，哪一件更适合你？
你觉得网上买东西比去商店更方便吗？为什么？
你的家乡什么东西不比大连的贵多少？

structureVariants.label: 程度更强
structureVariants.formula: A + 比 + B + 更 / 还 + 形容词
structureVariants.formulaEn: A + is even more + adjective + than + B
structureVariants.explanation: “更 / 还”放在形容词前，突出A的程度更高。

structureVariants.label: 差别不大
structureVariants.formula: A + 不比 + B + 形容词 + 多少
structureVariants.formulaEn: A + is not much more + adjective + than + B
structureVariants.explanation: 说明A没有明显超过B，两者比较接近。

followUp.promptEn: Compare the skirt and the shorts. Which looks better?

sampleAnswer.hanzi: 智能电视比旧电视更方便。

g07_03.scene: How do you show that a quality or feeling reaches a very high degree?
g07_03.structure: 形容词 / 心理动词 + 极了
g07_03.structureEn: Extremely: adjective or mental verb + 极了

leadExamples.english: This piece of watermelon is extremely sweet.
I like this book very much.

structureVariants.label: 形容词
structureVariants.explanation: 表示某种性质达到很高的程度。

structureVariants.label: 心理动词
structureVariants.formulaEn: Mental verb + 极了 = feel / like something very much
structureVariants.explanation: 表示喜欢、高兴、满意等感觉非常强。

sampleAnswer.pinyin: Zhè kuài xīguā tián jí le.

sampleAnswer.hanzi: 这条黄色短裤她喜欢极了。

g07_04.scene: How do you add a second, stronger reason when recommending a product?
g07_04.structure: 同主语：主语 + 不但……，而且……；不同主语：不但 + 主语1……，而且 + 主语2……

leadExamples.english: Modern televisions are not only affordable but also convenient.
leadExamples.hanzi: 现在的电视不但便宜，而且用着非常方便。

leadExamples.english: Jiayue not only likes singing; she sings well too.
leadExamples.hanzi: 家月不但喜欢唱歌，而且唱得很好听。

leadExamples.english: Not only Jiayue speaks Chinese; Tianzhong does too.
leadExamples.hanzi: 不但家月会说汉语，而且天中也会说汉语。

oralQuestions: 你常去的商店不但便宜，而且怎么样？
你的家乡不但有美食，而且还有什么？
班里谁不但汉语说得好，而且汉字也写得好？

structureVariants.label: 基本结构
structureVariants.explanation: 后一个分句在意思上进一步补充或加强前一个分句。
structureVariants.example: 这个电视不但便宜，而且方便。

structureVariants.label: 主语相同
structureVariants.formula: 主语 + 不但 + 谓语1，而且 + 谓语2
structureVariants.formulaEn: Same subject: Subject + not only + Predicate 1, but also + Predicate 2
structureVariants.explanation: 两个分句的主语相同，主语只说一次，放在“不但”前面。
structureVariants.example: 小雪不但会骑自行车，而且骑得很快。

structureVariants.label: 主语不同
structureVariants.formula: 不但 + 主语1 + 谓语1，而且 + 主语2 + 也 + 谓语2
structureVariants.formulaEn: Different subjects: Not only + Subject 1 + Predicate 1, but Subject 2 + also + Predicate 2
structureVariants.explanation: 两个分句的主语不同，“不但”放在主语1前，“而且”放在主语2前；常用“也”加强递进。
structureVariants.example: 不但哥哥喜欢这台电视，而且妹妹也喜欢。

followUp.promptEn: The smart TV is affordable and convenient. It can also go online.
followUp.target: 用“不但……而且……”推荐智能电视。

sampleAnswer.hanzi: 智能电视不但便宜，而且方便，还可以上网。
sampleAnswer.pinyin: Zhìnéng diànshì búdàn piányi, érqiě fāngbiàn, hái kěyǐ shàngwǎng.

followUp.promptEn: The parents notice the bicycle is old. Xiaoxue also thinks it is too short.
followUp.target: 用“主语不同”的结构说一句话。

sampleAnswer.hanzi: 不但爸爸妈妈觉得车旧了，而且小雪也觉得车太矮了。
sampleAnswer.pinyin: Búdàn bàba māma juéde chē jiù le, érqiě Xiǎoxuě yě juéde chē tài ǎi le.

g07_05.scene: Both words can mean “suitable,” but where do they go in a sentence?
g07_05.structure: 适合：事物 / 活动 + 适合 + 人 / 用途；合适：主语 + 很 / 不 + 合适
g07_05.structureEn: Word choice: 适合 vs. 合适

leadExamples.english: This yellow skirt suits you well.
leadExamples.hanzi: 这件黄色的裙子很适合你。

leadExamples.english: The size of these shoes is just right.

oralQuestions: 你觉得几点上课比较合适？
什么颜色的衣服适合你？
这辆自行车适合小雪吗？为什么？

structureVariants.label: 适合 · 动词
structureVariants.formula: 事物 / 活动 + 适合 + 人 / 用途
structureVariants.explanation: “适合”后面常带对象，回答“适合谁”或“适合做什么”。
structureVariants.example: 这件黄色的裙子很适合你。

structureVariants.label: 合适 · 形容词
structureVariants.formula: 大小 / 时间 / 价格 / 安排 + 很 / 不 + 合适
structureVariants.formulaEn: Size / time / price / arrangement + is + suitable / right
structureVariants.explanation: “合适”描述某个条件恰当，后面一般不直接带人或用途。

followUp.promptEn: The yellow shorts are the right size for her.
followUp.target: 选择“适合”或“合适”，说一个完整句子。

sampleAnswer.hanzi: 这条黄色短裤的大小很合适。
sampleAnswer.pinyin: Zhè tiáo huángsè duǎnkù de dàxiǎo hěn héshì.

followUp.promptEn: The bicycle is too short for Xiaoxue.
followUp.target: 选择“适合”或“合适”，说一个完整句子。

sampleAnswer.hanzi: 这辆自行车不适合小雪。
sampleAnswer.pinyin: Zhè liàng zìxíngchē bù shìhé Xiǎoxuě.

practiceItems.reason: 描述“大小”恰当，用形容词“合适”。
后面直接带对象“你”，用动词“适合”。

practiceItems.reason: 后面带对象“小雪”，用“适合”。

instructions.required: 完成“我的购物建议”的当次准备卡；最终作品主要在课堂展示。
instructions.optional: 不需要上传录音。A 的需求图片和 B 的比较表会直接用于 C。
instructions.aiPolicy: 先独立选择商品、图片和信息，再使用工具检查语言。

A.label: 购物建议 · 第1步
A.goal: 选择一个需要更换或购买的物品，准备图片和购买原因。
A.suggested_mix: 完成需求卡；下次课向同伴说明现状。

B.label: 购物建议 · 第2步
B.goal: 比较两个商品选择，记录价格、大小、颜色或特点并做决定。
B.suggested_mix: 完成比较表；课堂两人互相检查比较句。

C.label: 课堂最终项目 · 我的购物建议
C.goal: 整合 A 和 B，完成1—2分钟购物推荐。
C.suggested_mix: 不强制上传录音；课堂先小组彩排，再展示。

A.projectStage: 购物建议 1/3 · 发现需要
A.prompt_cn: 你有什么东西太旧、太小或不合适，需要更换或购买？
A.prompt_en: Choose one item that is too old, too small or unsuitable and needs replacing or buying.
A.answerPlaceholder: 我的……已经……了。我需要……，因为……。

A.projectStage: 购物建议 1/3 · 保存到最终展示
A.prompt_cn: 准备一张物品图片，写出现状、需要更换的原因和购买时要试什么。
A.prompt_en: Prepare one item photo. Describe its current condition, why it needs replacing, and what you should try or check before buying.
A.answerPlaceholder: 物品：……；现在：……；需要更换，因为……；购买以前要试/检查……。
picturePrompts: 新物品需要的大小或特点

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 使用句框写3句话，说明物品和问题。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 写4—5句话，使用“旧、太……、大小、合适”中的三个。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 补充一种替代方案，并说明购买前要怎样试。

A.projectStage: 下一次课 · Item Need Card
A.prompt_en: Prepare the item and the reason it needs replacing.
presentationPlan: Bring one clear photo of an item that needs replacing or buying.
Be ready to answer: What is the item? What is wrong with it? Why do you need a new one?
Use at least three of these expressions: 旧, 太……, 大小, 合适, 试一下.
You may discuss ideas with a partner. No audio upload is required.
A.classroomNote: Keep this need card. You will use it in your final shopping recommendation.

B.projectStage: 购物建议 2/3 · 找到两个选择
B.prompt_cn: 为 Homework A 的物品找到两个可以比较的商品。它们最重要的不同是什么？
B.prompt_en: Find two product choices for the item from Homework A. What are the most important differences?
B.answerPlaceholder: 选择A是……；选择B是……；它们的……不一样。

B.projectStage: 购物建议 2/3 · 保存比较结果
B.prompt_cn: 比较两个商品的价格、大小、颜色或特点，至少写三个比较句并做决定。
B.prompt_en: Compare two products by price, size, color or features. Write at least three comparison sentences and make a decision.
B.answerPlaceholder: A比B更……。A不比B……多少。A的大小很合适，也更适合我。我决定……，因为……。

carryFrom.label: A · 我的需求与理由卡

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 填写比较表，完成两个比较句和一个决定句。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 写三个不同维度的比较句，并正确使用“适合”或“合适”。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 加入促销、使用体验或长期价值，解释哪个选择更值得。

B.prompt_en: Prepare a clear comparison of your two product choices.
presentationPlan: Bring your Homework A item card and two product images.
Include the price and at least two features for each product.
Use 比……更…… and 不比……多少, then make a decision.
Work may be checked with a partner. No audio upload is required.
B.classroomNote: Save the two choices and your decision for the final recommendation.

C.projectStage: 购物建议 3/3 · 组织推荐
C.prompt_cn: 听众最需要知道哪三个信息，才能接受你的购买建议？
C.prompt_en: Which three pieces of information will help your audience understand and accept your recommendation?

C.projectStage: 课堂大作业 · 我的购物建议
C.prompt_cn: 整合需要、两项商品比较和最后决定，准备1—2分钟“我的购物建议”。
C.prompt_en: Combine the need, two product choices, comparison and final decision into a 1–2 minute Smart Shopper Recommendation.
C.answerPlaceholder: 我的……已经……，所以需要……。A比B更……，但A不比B……多少。A很适合我，大小也很合适。A不但……，而且……。我决定……，因为……。

scaffoldLevels.label: 基础层 / Support
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 按“需要—比较—决定”使用6个句框完成展示。

scaffoldLevels.label: 标准层 / Core
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 使用至少6个本课词和2个语法结构，完成约1分钟推荐。

scaffoldLevels.label: 挑战层 / Challenge
scaffoldLevels.instruction: 加入价格单位、促销或智能功能，回应同学的一个问题，完成约2分钟推荐。

C.projectStage: 最终回收 · Smart Shopper Recommendation
C.prompt_en: Present your Smart Shopper Recommendation mainly in class.
presentationPlan: Bring one to three images: the item you need, product A and product B. Include useful price, size, color or feature information.
Answer: What do you need? Why? What are the two choices? How are they different? Which one do you recommend and why?
Use at least six lesson words and at least two structures: V1着V2, 比……更……, 不比……多少, 极了, or 不但……而且…….
Speak for 1–2 minutes. You may work in pairs or small groups, but every student must explain one comparison or reason.
Present mainly in class. Audio upload is not required.
C.classroomNote: Use the need card from A and the comparison card from B. Mistakes and weak points stay collapsed until you choose to review them.

recommendationRules.then: 重做对应五步预习并复习错词。
用需求卡和比较卡重新完成一次购物建议。
